expected_result.endpoint_definition: Radiographic PFS: time from randomization to first radiological evidence of progressive disease assessed by independent central review, or death from any cause within 24 weeks of drug discontinuation; progression defined by RECIST 1.1
expected_result.population: Patients in the randomized intention-to-treat or primary efficacy analysis population.

reported_scope.analysis_population: Patients in the randomized intention-to-treat or primary efficacy analysis population.

expected_result.window: From randomization to the outcome event or last follow-up at the analysis cutoff reported in the main article.

registry_capture.provenance: captured response retained from PFS baseline
